name: Glucose syrup
aliases: glucose syrup, corn syrup, liquid glucose, glucose-fructose syrup, high fructose corn syrup, HFCS, fructose syrup, jarabe de glucosa, sirop de glucose
what_is: A sweet, thick liquid made by hydrolyzing plant starch into simple sugars.
why_botia: BOTIA flags glucose syrup because it is made by breaking starch down into sugars, so it provides rapidly available carbohydrate even though the word "sugar" may not appear on the label. When a product contains several different sugars, each is listed separately by its own weight, so none may appear near the top even though together they contribute a substantial amount. WHO counts the sugars added through glucose syrup as free sugars.
can_1: Flag the ingredient as an added sugar.
can_2: Trigger an ultra-processed classification under the NOVA system.
cannot_1: Verify the exact ratio of glucose to fructose unless specified by terms like high-fructose corn syrup.
cannot_2: Measure the amount of added sugars in grams directly from the text of the ingredient list.
title: Glucose syrup
description: A sweet, thick liquid made by hydrolyzing plant starch into simple sugars.
